title: Police Blotter: Webb County Misdemeanor Roundup — 21 Booked Oct. 20–21
excerpt: Twenty-one people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Oct. 20–21, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges — DWI, assault, trespass and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Twenty-one people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday and Wednesday, October 20–21, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Rene Gilberto Leyva

Leyva was arrested on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 3:33 p.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Raul Joel Herrera de Jesus

Herrera de Jesus was arrested on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 3:22 p.m. on a charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond amount or case number was listed. The record shows an out-of-county hold.

Jimena Riojas

Riojas was arrested on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 2:46 p.m. on a charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Mariela Capetillo

Capetillo was arrested on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 2:41 p.m. on a charge of harassment, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000.

Chris Orlando Torres

Chris Orlando Torres — arrested by the Laredo Police Department on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 8:48 p.m. Charged with assault causing bodily injury — family member (Class A misdemeanor). Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

Tremondre McGhee

Tremondre McGhee — arrested on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 10:54 p.m. Charged with (1) failure to identify — giving false or fictitious information (Class B misdemeanor) and (2) resisting arrest, search or transport (Class A misdemeanor). Bond had not been set on either charge as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record lists his city as Albuquerque, New Mexico; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

Marta Bravo

Marta Bravo was arrested Tuesday night, October 20, 2026, at 8:52 p.m. and booked on one count of DRIVING WHILE INTOXICATED/OPEN ALCH CONTAINER — a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging driving while intoxicated with an open alcohol container in the vehicle. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record lists her city as Laredo, Texas; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

Darrick Carl Campbell

Darrick Carl Campbell was arrested early Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, at 12:11 a.m. and booked on one count of CRIMINAL MISCHIEF >=$100<$750 — a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging damage or destruction of property valued between $100 and $750. Bond was set at $500. The booking record lists his city as Austin, Texas; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

Sulema Dalia Sanchez

Sulema Dalia Sanchez was arrested early Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, at 1:20 a.m. and booked on one count of CRIMINAL TRESPASS — a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging entering or remaining on someone else's property after being told to leave. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department, per the Odyssey jail search; the record lists her city as Laredo, Texas.

Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department, per the Odyssey jail search; the record lists his city as Laredo, Texas.

Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department, per the Odyssey jail search; the record lists her city as Rio Bravo, Texas.

Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record; it lists his city as Laredo, Texas.

The arresting agency was the Texas Department of Public Safety. No case number was listed in the booking record.

Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956, and no court case number was listed. The booking record lists his city as Houston, Texas; he is being held on an out-of-county/state hold, and the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

Jose Guadalupe Castillo

JOSE GUADALUPE CASTILLO — Castillo was arrested at 12:47 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated. Bond was set at $1,500. He is also being held on an out-of-county/state hold. The booking record listed the city as Mexico.
